title.en: EMSD inspection: 152 of 192 buildings with lifts by Tai Yat lacked door-frame components
title.zh_hans: 机电署抽检：台日安装192幢楼宇中152幢无装升降机门框组件　余下约180幢待查
title.zh_hant: 機電署抽檢：臺日安裝192幢樓宇中152幢無裝升降機門框組件　餘下約180幢待查

summary.en: Hong Kong's Electrical and Mechanical Services Department reported that of 192 buildings with lifts installed by Tai Yat Elevator inspected so far, 152 lacked required door-frame components. Except for two public housing estate cases announced on October 15, all affected buildings are private. About 180 more buildings await inspection, with installation costs borne by the contractor.
summary.zh_hans: 机电署公布最新抽检结果，由台日电梯安装的楼宇完成巡查192幢，当中152幢没有安装升降机门框组件，除了两个租置屋邨个案，其余全部是私人楼宇。署方指还有约180幢由台日负责的楼宇未查，不符要求数字预计再升，安装工程费用一律由承办商承担。
summary.zh_hant: 機電署公布最新抽檢結果，由臺日電梯安裝嘅樓宇完成巡查192幢，當中152幢冇裝升降機門框組件，除咗兩個租置屋邨個案，其餘全係私人樓宇。署方指仲有約180幢由臺日負責嘅樓宇未查，不符要求數字預料再升，門框組件安裝工程費用一律由承辦商承擔。

title.en: Vietnam central bank orders lenders to cut manufacturing loan rates by 1.5 to 2 percentage points
title.zh_hans: 越南央行责令贷款机构降息　制造业贷款利率降1.5至2个百分点
title.zh_hant: 越南央行責令貸款機構降息　製造業貸款利率降1.5至2個百分點

summary.en: Vietnam's central bank has ordered commercial lenders to cut lending rates for manufacturing and priority sectors by 1.5 to 2 percentage points to support economic growth, and to lower deposit rates of six months or longer by at least 0.5 percentage points, while demanding stronger bad-loan management.
summary.zh_hans: 越南国家银行出手撑经济，责令商业贷款机构将制造业和重点行业贷款利率下调1.5至2个百分点，6个月或以上存款利率至少下调0.5个百分点。央行同时要求银行进一步管理不良贷款，确保银行体系安全。
summary.zh_hant: 越南國家銀行出手撐經濟，責令商業貸款機構將製造業同重點行業貸款利率下調1.5至2個百分點，6個月或以上存款利率至少下調0.5個百分點。央行同時要求銀行進一步管理不良貸款，確保銀行體系安全。

title.en: Bank of Korea to decide rates Oct 22; analysts expect 'hawkish pause' with November hike possible
title.zh_hans: 韩国央行22日议息　市场料“鹰式暂停”　11月或再加息
title.zh_hant: 韓國央行22日議息　市場料「鷹式暫停」　11月或再加息

summary.en: The Bank of Korea meets on October 22, and analysts expect a "hawkish pause" after back-to-back quarter-point hikes in July and August brought the policy rate to 3.00%. With inflation stubbornly high, brokerages see a November hike likely, with the terminal rate reaching 3.50-3.75%.
summary.zh_hans: 韩国央行星期四（22日）议息，市场普遍预期在连续两次加息之后会维持利率不变，但保留进一步紧缩空间，属于“鹰式暂停”。由于通胀居高不下，券商预期11月仍会再加息，终点利率可能升至3.50至3.75%。
summary.zh_hant: 韓國央行星期四（22日）議息，市場普遍預期喺連續兩次加息之後會維持利率不變，但保留進一步緊縮空間，屬於「鷹式暫停」。由於通脹居高不下，券商預期11月仍會再加息，終點利率可能升至3.50至3.75%。總統李在明早前已公開表示利率上升不可避免。

title.en: China drafts revision of tech export control list covering AI, biopharma and solar
title.zh_hans: 中国修订《禁止出口限制出口技术目录》　AI、生物医药、光伏40项关键技术征意见
title.zh_hant: 中國修訂《禁止出口限制出口技術目錄》　AI、生物醫藥、光伏40項關鍵技術徵意見

summary.en: China's commerce and technology ministries have published a draft revision of the catalogue of technologies prohibited or restricted from export, seeking public comment on 40 key technologies across AI, biopharmaceuticals and solar — 14 proposed for prohibition and 26 for restriction. The commerce ministry says this is routine tech-trade management, not targeting any specific country.
summary.zh_hans: 商务部和科技部宣布修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》，就拟增列的40项关键技术公开征求意见，涵盖人工智能、生物医药和光伏三个领域，其中14项拟禁止出口、26项拟限制出口，并实施出口前登记临时管理措施。商务部强调此次修订属常态化技术贸易管理，不针对任何特定国家。
summary.zh_hant: 商務部同科技部宣布修訂《中國禁止出口限制出口技術目錄》，就擬增列嘅40項關鍵技術公開徵求意見，涵蓋人工智能、生物醫藥同光伏三個領域，其中14項擬禁止出口、26項擬限制出口，並實施出口前登記臨時管理措施。商務部強調今次修訂屬常態化技術貿易管理，不針對任何特定國家。

title.en: Nvidia unveils RTX Spark AI notebooks in Seoul; 128GB models run large models locally with no token fees
title.zh_hans: NVIDIA RTX Spark AI笔电首尔发布　128GB内存本地跑大模型免Token收费
title.zh_hant: NVIDIA RTX Spark AI筆電首爾發布　128GB記憶體本地跑大模型免Token收費

summary.en: Nvidia has launched its RTX Spark AI notebooks in Seoul, pairing Blackwell GPUs with Grace CPUs and up to 128GB of unified memory for 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. Top models can run large AI models and agents locally on the laptop, eliminating per-token cloud charges. Six PC makers including Asus, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI began sales, from $2,599 globally.
summary.zh_hans: NVIDIA在首尔正式发布RTX Spark AI笔电，搭载Blackwell加Grace超级芯片、最高128GB统一内存，算力高达1 petaflop，可在本地直接运行大型AI模型，不用再付按Token计费的云端费用。产品由Asus、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft、MSI六家厂商同步开售，全球售价2,599美元起。
summary.zh_hant: NVIDIA喺首爾正式發布RTX Spark AI筆電，搭載Blackwell加Grace超級芯片、最高128GB統一記憶體，算力高達1 petaflop，可喺本地直接運行大型AI模型，唔使再畀按Token計費嘅雲端費用。產品由Asus、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft、MSI六家廠商同步開售，全球售價2,599美元起。

title.en: Gaza holds mass funeral for 75 recovered remains; about 8,000 still buried under rubble
title.zh_hans: 加沙为75名从瓦砾下寻回罹难者举行集体葬礼　仍有约8000人埋于瓦砾下
title.zh_hant: 加沙為75名從瓦礫下尋回罹難者舉行集體葬禮　仍有約8000人埋於瓦礫下

summary.en: Gaza held a mass funeral on Sunday for 75 Palestinians whose remains were recovered in recent weeks from rubble in Gaza City's Daraj neighborhood, belonging to around 20 families, mostly women and children. Gaza's Civil Defence says about 8,000 Palestinians remain buried under rubble across the enclave, with recovery hampered by a lack of heavy machinery.
summary.zh_hans: 加沙星期日为75名从瓦砾下寻回的罹难者举行集体葬礼，遗骸在过去几星期陆续从加沙城Daraj区被炸毁的房屋挖出，属于约20个家庭，多数是妇孺。加沙民防表示，估计仍有约8000名巴勒斯坦人埋在全境瓦砾之下，但缺乏重型机械令搜寻工作举步维艰。
summary.zh_hant: 加沙星期日為75名從瓦礫下尋回嘅罹難者舉行集體葬禮，遺骸喺過去幾星期陸續從加沙城Daraj區被炸毀嘅房屋挖出，屬於約20個家庭，多數係婦孺。加沙民防表示，估計仍有約8,000名巴勒斯坦人埋喺全境瓦礫之下，但缺乏重型機械令搜尋工作舉步維艱。

title.en: Louis Koo celebrates 56th birthday with 800 fans in mini-concert party
title.zh_hans: 古天乐56岁生日会变迷你演唱会　联同近800粉丝唱爆舞台
title.zh_hant: 古天樂56歲生日會變迷你演唱會　聯同近800粉絲唱爆舞台

summary.en: Hong Kong star Louis Koo celebrated his upcoming 56th birthday on Saturday night with nearly 800 fans, turning the party into a mini-concert where he performed several of his classic songs. Veteran guests including Law Lan and Fung So-bor attended.
summary.zh_hans: 古天乐10月21日就56岁，提前在星期六晚举行生日会，与近800位粉丝欢聚一晚。今次生日派对以演唱会形式举行，古仔穿着抢眼鲜红色外套，在台上连唱多首金曲，罗兰、冬婶、冯素波等亦是座上客，全场气氛高涨。
summary.zh_hant: 古天樂10月21日就56歲，提前喺星期六晚舉行生日會，同近800位粉絲歡聚一晚。今次生日派對以演唱會形式舉行，古仔著住搶眼鮮紅色外套，喺台上連唱多首金曲，羅蘭、冬嬸、馮素波等亦係座上客，全場氣氛高漲。

title.en: Eason Chan's 26 recording-session shows hit scalping frenzy before sale; final show listed above HK$13,000
title.zh_hans: 陈奕迅26场录音演出未开卖掀炒卖潮　尾场炒至逾1.3万　歌迷促实名制
title.zh_hant: 陳奕迅26場錄音演出未開賣掀炒賣潮　尾場炒至逾1.3萬　歌迷促實名制

summary.en: Eason Chan will hold 26 live recording sessions at the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts from December to February, re-recording classic albums in front of audiences who must seal their phones and stay silent during takes. Tickets haven't gone on sale, yet scalpers list the final show at HK$13,563. Fans are demanding a lottery-plus-real-name system like Hebe Tien's Taipei shows.
summary.zh_hans: 陈奕迅年底将在香港演艺学院举行26场公开录音演出，观众入场要封存手机，录音期间不可以交谈、欢呼、跟唱。门票尚未开卖，网上已出现炒卖，明年2月尾场被炒至逾1.3万元。歌迷质疑主办方没有推行实名制，助长黄牛党，要求跟随田馥甄在台北小巨蛋的“抽签加实名制”做法。
summary.zh_hant: 陳奕迅年底將喺香港演藝學院舉行26場公開錄音演出，觀眾入場要封存手機，錄音期間唔可以交談、歡呼、跟唱。門票尚未開賣，網上已出現炒賣，明年2月尾場被炒至逾1.3萬元。歌迷質疑主辦方冇推行實名制，助長黃牛黨，要求跟隨田馥甄喺台北小巨蛋嘅「抽籤加實名制」做法。

title.en: HK Observatory: sunny and scorching 32°C today, Yellow fire danger warning in force
title.zh_hans: 天文台：今日天晴干燥炎热　市区最高32度　黄色火灾危险警告生效
title.zh_hant: 天文台：今日天晴乾燥炎熱　市區最高32度　黃色火災危險警告生效

summary.en: The Hong Kong Observatory forecasts a sunny, dry and hot Monday, with urban highs around 32°C and a couple of degrees higher in the New Territories, under light to moderate easterlies. The Yellow fire danger warning is currently in force, meaning fire risk is high. The coming days will stay mainly fine and dry, with Wednesday turning very hot up to 33°C; the path of Tropical Cyclone Qiangpi remains uncertain.
summary.zh_hans: 天文台预测今日（星期一）天晴，日间干燥炎热，市区最高气温约32度，新界再高一两度，吹轻微至和缓偏东风。现时黄色火灾危险警告正生效，表示火灾危险性颇高。展望未来数日大致天晴干燥，星期三日间酷热，最高可达33度。热带气旋蔷琵路径仍存在变数，市民应留意天文台最新消息。
summary.zh_hant: 天文台預測今日（星期一）天晴，日間乾燥炎熱，市區最高氣溫約32度，新界再高一兩度，吹輕微至和緩偏東風。現時黃色火災危險警告正生效，表示火災危險性頗高。展望未來數日大致天晴乾燥，星期三日間酷熱，最高可達33度。熱帶氣旋薔琵路徑仍然存在變數，市民應留意天文台最新消息。

title.en: CHP investigating death of 9-year-old boy from invasive pneumococcal disease
title.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心调查9岁男童侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡个案
title.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心調查9歲男童侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡個案

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating the death of a previously healthy 9-year-old boy from invasive pneumococcal disease. He developed fever, runny nose and cough on October 10, was admitted via Tin Shui Wai Hospital A&E on October 14 and transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital's paediatric ICU, where he died on October 15. Lab tests confirmed pneumococcus; the clinical diagnosis was pneumonia complicated by empyema, septic shock and acute renal failure. The CHP urges parents to ensure children receive pneumococcal conjugate vaccines on schedule and to seek care early for fever and respiratory symptoms.
summary.zh_hans: 卫生署卫生防护中心正调查一宗侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡个案。病人为一名9岁男童，过往健康良好，本月10日起出现发烧、流鼻水及咳嗽等病征，14日经天水围医院急症室转送屯门医院儿童深切治疗部，15日不治。化验证实对肺炎球菌呈阳性，临床诊断为肺炎并发脓胸、败血性休克及急性肾衰竭。中心呼吁家长确保子女按时接种肺炎球菌结合疫苗，幼童出现发烧及呼吸道病征应及早求医。
summary.zh_hant: 衞生署衞生防護中心正調查一宗侵入性肺炎球菌病死亡個案。病人為一名9歲男童，過往健康良好，本月10日起出現發燒、流鼻水及咳嗽等病徵，14日經天水圍醫院急症室轉送屯門醫院兒童深切治療部，15日不治。化驗證實對肺炎球菌呈陽性，臨床診斷為肺炎併發膿胸、敗血性休克及急性腎衰竭。中心呼籲家長確保子女按時接種肺炎球菌結合疫苗，幼童出現發燒及呼吸道病徵應及早求醫。

title.en: Customs busts two airport drug trafficking cases, seizes drugs worth about HK$6.8 million
title.zh_hans: 海关机场侦破两宗入境旅客贩毒案　检市值约680万港元毒品
title.zh_hant: 海關機場偵破兩宗入境旅客販毒案　檢市值約680萬港元毒品

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs cracked two inbound passenger drug trafficking cases at Hong Kong International Airport over October 17-18, seizing about 5.4kg of suspected cocaine, about 17kg of suspected cannabis buds and 15 suspected alprazolam pills, with an estimated total market value of about HK$6.8 million. In the first case, a 40-year-old mainland male passenger arriving from Sao Paulo via Istanbul was found with the suspected cocaine in his hand luggage. In the second, a 52-year-old mainland female passenger arriving from Bangkok was caught with suspected cannabis buds in checked luggage and the pills in her backpack. Both were arrested and investigations continue.
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关一连两日（17日及18日）在香港国际机场侦破两宗入境旅客贩毒案件，共检获约5.4公斤怀疑可卡因、约17公斤怀疑大麻花及15粒怀疑阿普唑仑，估计市值共约680万港元。首宗案件中，一名40岁内地男旅客从巴西圣保罗经伊斯坦堡飞抵本港，海关在其手提行李内搜出怀疑可卡因；第二宗案件中，一名52岁内地女旅客从曼谷抵港，在其寄仓行李及随身背包内搜出怀疑大麻花及药丸。两人均已被捕，案件仍在调查中。
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關一連兩日（17日及18日）在香港國際機場偵破兩宗入境旅客販毒案件，共檢獲約5.4公斤懷疑可卡因、約17公斤懷疑大麻花及15粒懷疑阿普唑侖，估計市值共約680萬港元。首宗案件中，一名40歲內地男旅客從巴西聖保羅經伊斯坦堡飛抵本港，海關在其手提行李內搜出懷疑可卡因；第二宗案件中，一名52歲內地女旅客從曼谷抵港，在其寄倉行李及隨身背包內搜出懷疑大麻花及藥丸。兩人均已被捕，案件仍在調查中。

title.en: French nationwide protests turn violent: over 1,200 arrested, 143-year-old city hall torched
title.zh_hans: 法国全国示威演变成骚乱　逾1200人被捕　百年市政厅遭焚
title.zh_hant: 法國全國示威演變成騷亂　逾1200人被捕　百年市政廳遭焚

summary.en: Massive nationwide protests erupted across France on October 17 over soaring living costs and declining public services. The Interior Ministry put turnout at about 550,000, while unions claimed up to 800,000. Violence broke out in Paris, Marseille, Lyon and Limoges, where radicals set fires, vandalised public facilities and looted shops; more than 1,200 people were arrested and over 150 police officers injured. In Limoges, a 143-year-old city hall dating to 1883 was broken into and torched, suffering severe damage. President Emmanuel Macron condemned the violence and vowed to prosecute the attackers.
summary.zh_hans: 法国17日爆发全国性大规模示威，抗议生活成本飙涨及公共服务质素下降。内政部统计全国约55万人参与，工会则估计达80万人。巴黎、马赛、里昂及利摩日等多地出现暴力冲突，部分激进分子纵火、破坏公共设施及洗劫商店，逾1200人被捕，超过150名警察受伤。利摩日一座建于1883年、有143年历史的市政厅遭人闯入纵火，严重受损。总统马克宏谴责暴力行为，誓言惩处施袭者。
summary.zh_hant: 法國17日爆發全國性大規模示威，抗議生活成本飆漲及公共服務質素下降。內政部統計全國約55萬人參與，工會則估計達80萬人。巴黎、馬賽、里昂及利摩日等多地出現暴力衝突，部分激進分子縱火、破壞公共設施及洗劫商店，逾1200人被捕，超過150名警察受傷。利摩日一座建於1883年、有143年歷史的市政廳遭人闖入縱火，嚴重受損。總統馬克宏譴責暴力行為，誓言懲處施襲者。

title.en: HK stock market closed for public holiday as China set to release Q3 economic data at 10am
title.zh_hans: 港股今日休市　国家统计局今早10时公布第三季经济数据
title.zh_hant: 港股今日休市　國家統計局今早10時公布第三季經濟數據

summary.en: Hong Kong's spot securities market is closed today (October 19), the day after the Chung Yeung Festival public holiday, and will reopen tomorrow. Market focus shifts to the mainland: the National Bureau of Statistics will release third-quarter and September national economic data at 10am today, covering GDP and monthly indicators. Last week the Hang Seng Index was almost flat, edging down 0.10% to 24,186.83 points, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbled 11.41% and Korea's KOSPI plunged 14.46%.
summary.zh_hans: 今日（10月19日）为重阳节翌日公众假期，香港现货证券市场休市一日，明日（20日）重开。市场焦点转向内地：国家统计局将于今早10时公布第三季及9月份国民经济运行情况，涵盖GDP及月度指标。上周恒指近乎持平，微跌0.10%，收报24186.83点；费城半导体指数一周急跌11.41%，韩国KOSPI更大跌14.46%。
summary.zh_hant: 今日（10月19日）為重陽節翌日公眾假期，香港現貨證券市場休市一日，明日（20日）重開。市場焦點轉向內地：國家統計局將於今早10時公布第三季及9月份國民經濟運行情況，涵蓋GDP及月度指標。上週恒指近乎持平，微跌0.10%，收報24186.83點；費城半導體指數一週急跌11.41%，韓國KOSPI更大跌14.46%。

title.en: Paul Lam heads to Brunei for 16th China-ASEAN prosecutors-general meeting
title.zh_hant: 林定國下午赴文萊　出席中國—東盟成員國總檢察長會議
title.zh_hans: 林定国下午赴文莱　出席中国—东盟成员国总检察长会议

summary.en: Secretary for Justice Paul Lam departed for Brunei this afternoon to attend the 16th China-ASEAN Prosecutors-General Meeting. He will join as a member of the Chinese delegation and speak on protecting children in the digital age, discussing stronger international cooperation against online crimes targeting children. Lam will introduce Hong Kong's legal framework for child protection, noting that while tech innovation brings opportunities, children face unprecedented risks including non-consensual intimate images and deepfakes. He is accompanied by Director of Public Prosecutions Chau Tin-hang and government counsel, and returns on October 23; Deputy Secretary Cheung Kwok-kwan will act in his absence.
summary.zh_hant: 律政司司長林定國今日下午啟程前往文萊，出席第十六屆中國—東盟成員國總檢察長會議及相關活動。他將以中國代表團成員身分出席會議，並在討論環節就「數碼時代保護兒童」主題發表演說，與東盟成員國探討加強國際合作，保護兒童免受網絡罪行威脅。林定國將向與會者介紹香港現行保護兒童的法律框架，科技創新帶來機遇之餘，亦令兒童面臨未經同意發布私密影像及深度偽造等前所未有的風險。陪同出訪的人員包括刑事檢控專員周天行和政府律師；他將於十月二十三日返港，離港期間由律政司副司長張國鈞署理職務。
summary.zh_hans: 律政司司长林定国今日下午启程前往文莱，出席第十六届中国—东盟成员国总检察长会议及相关活动。他将以中国代表团成员身份出席会议，并在讨论环节就「数码时代保护儿童」主题发表演说，与东盟成员国探讨加强国际合作，保护儿童免受网络罪行威胁。林定国将向与会者介绍香港现行保护儿童的法律框架，科技创新带来机遇之余，亦令儿童面临未经同意发布私密影像及深度伪造等前所未有的风险。陪同出访的人员包括刑事检控专员周天行和政府律师；他将于十月二十三日返港，离港期间由律政司副司长张国钧署理职务。

title.en: Macron condemns violent unrest across France as nearly 2,400 arrested
title.zh_hant: 馬克龍譴責法國多地暴力事件　當局稱拘捕近二千四百人
title.zh_hans: 马克龙谴责法国多地暴力事件　当局称拘捕近二千四百人

summary.en: French President Emmanuel Macron delivered a televised address on October 18 condemning the violent unrest that swept across France the previous day, stressing that no cause can justify violence and offenders will face legal consequences. Updated official figures show 2,397 arrests and 997 police and gendarmes injured, seven seriously, during the October 17 protests. Around 550,000 people joined the demonstrations nationwide, though unions put the figure at 800,000. Macron said he understood young people's anxieties and announced the government would consult students, teachers and unions over the coming week; he will also visit Gulf states on the 19th to secure France's energy supply.
summary.zh_hant: 法國總統馬克龍10月18日發表電視講話，譴責前一日在全國多地爆發的暴力事件，強調任何理由都不能為暴力開脫，違法者將被追究法律責任。當局最新統計指，17日的示威中有2,397人被捕，997名警察和憲兵受傷，其中7人傷勢嚴重；全國約55萬人上街，工會則稱達80萬人。馬克龍表示理解青年群體的焦慮，政府未來一周將與學生、教師及工會商討應對措施；他亦宣布將於19日訪問海灣國家，確保法國能源供應。
summary.zh_hans: 法国总统马克龙10月18日发表电视讲话，谴责前一日在全国多地爆发的暴力事件，强调任何理由都不能为暴力开脱，违法者将被追究法律责任。当局最新统计指，17日的示威中有2,397人被捕，997名警察和宪兵受伤，其中7人伤势严重；全国约55万人上街，工会则称达80万人。马克龙表示理解青年群体的焦虑，政府未来一周将与学生、教师及工会商讨应对措施；他亦宣布将于19日访问海湾国家，确保法国能源供应。

title.en: Putin proposes Trump-Xi meeting on Ukraine, sidelining Zelenskyy, WSJ reports
title.zh_hant: 傳普丁邀川普、習近平三方會談烏克蘭問題　澤倫斯基被排除在外
title.zh_hans: 传普丁邀川普、习近平三方会谈乌克兰问题　泽连斯基被排除在外

summary.en: The Wall Street Journal, citing sources, reports that Russian President Vladimir Putin has proposed meeting US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping next month to discuss Ukraine and seek an end to the four-year war. The meeting could take place on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on November 18-19. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed the three sides are discussing the idea, but Trump has not agreed to attend. A three-way summit held without Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy would be unprecedented and is set to alarm European allies.
summary.zh_hant: 《華爾街日報》引述消息人士報道，俄羅斯總統普丁提議下月與美國總統川普及中國國家主席習近平會面，討論烏克蘭問題，尋求結束這場延續四年的戰爭。消息指會面或安排在11月18日至19日於深圳舉行的APEC峰會期間舉行，克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫證實三方正就此討論，但川普尚未同意出席。若在烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基缺席下舉行三方峰會，將是前所未見的安排，勢必引起歐洲盟友警戒。
summary.zh_hans: 《华尔街日报》引述消息人士报道，俄罗斯总统普丁提议下月与美国总统川普及中国国家主席习近平会面，讨论乌克兰问题，寻求结束这场延续四年的战争。消息指会面或安排在11月18日至19日于深圳举行的APEC峰会期间举行，克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫证实三方正就此讨论，但川普尚未同意出席。若在乌克兰总统泽伦斯基缺席下举行三方峰会，将是前所未见的安排，势必引起欧洲盟友警戒。

title.en: 2026 Financial Street Forum opens in Beijing with top regulators to speak
title.zh_hant: 2026金融街論壇年會今日開幕　四家金融監管部門負責人將發表演講
title.zh_hans: 2026金融街论坛年会今日开幕　四家金融监管部门负责人将发表演讲

summary.en: The 2026 Financial Street Forum annual meeting opened today in Beijing's Financial Street and runs through October 22, themed 'Openness, Cooperation, Inclusiveness: Building a New Ecosystem for Global Financial Development'. More than 400 guests from over 40 countries and regions are attending. People's Bank of China governor Pan Gongsheng, National Financial Regulatory Administration chief Ding Xiangqun, CSRC chairman Wu Qing and SAFE administrator Zhu Hexin will deliver keynote speeches. The forum is seen as a key window into China's financial policy direction.
summary.zh_hant: 2026金融街論壇年會今日起至22日在北京金融街舉行，主題為「開放·合作·包容——共築全球金融發展新生態」，吸引全球40多個國家和地區400餘位嘉賓出席。中國人民銀行行長潘功勝、國家金融監督管理總局局長丁向群、中國證監會主席吳清及國家外匯管理局局長朱鶴新將出席並作主題演講。論壇被視為觀察中國金融政策走向的重要窗口。
summary.zh_hans: 2026金融街论坛年会今日起至22日在北京金融街举行，主题为「开放·合作·包容——共筑全球金融发展新生态」，吸引全球40多个国家和地区400余位嘉宾出席。中国人民银行行长潘功胜、国家金融监督管理总局局长丁向群、中国证监会主席吴清及国家外汇管理局局长朱鹤新将出席并作主题演讲。论坛被视为观察中国金融政策走向的重要窗口。

title.en: China's railways carry record 3.71 billion passengers in first three quarters
title.zh_hant: 前三季度全國鐵路發送旅客37.1億人次　創歷史同期新高
title.zh_hans: 前三季度全国铁路发送旅客37.1亿人次　创历史同期新高

summary.en: China's railways carried 3.71 billion passengers in the first three quarters of this year, up 4.8% year on year and a record high for the period. The sustained growth in rail travel reflects strong travel demand and expanding network capacity. The figures, released today, are seen as an important gauge of economic activity on the mainland.
summary.zh_hant: 今年前三季度，全國鐵路累計發送旅客37.1億人次，同比增長4.8%，創歷史同期新高。鐵路客運持續增長，反映出行需求旺盛，亦顯示鐵路網絡運力不斷提升。數據由官方今日公布，成為衡量內地經濟活動熱度的重要指標之一。
summary.zh_hans: 今年前三季度，全国铁路累计发送旅客37.1亿人次，同比增长4.8%，创历史同期新高。铁路客运持续增长，反映出行需求旺盛，亦显示铁路网络运力不断提升。数据由官方今日公布，成为衡量内地经济活动热度的重要指标之一。

title.en: India curbs sugarcane-based ethanol to rein in soaring sugar prices
title.zh_hant: 印度限制以甘蔗原料生產乙醇　抑制糖價上漲
title.zh_hans: 印度限制以甘蔗原料生产乙醇　抑制糖价上涨

summary.en: India has ordered state-run fuel retailers to stop buying ethanol made from sugar and key sugarcane feedstocks in a bid to curb rising sugar prices, effective from the new supply year starting November 1. State refiners jointly issued a tender to procure nearly 11 billion litres of ethanol for the new supply year, explicitly rejecting bids for ethanol produced from cane juice, sugar, syrup and B-heavy molasses. India is the world's second-largest sugar producer; a strong El Nino brought its weakest monsoon rains in over a decade, tightening supply, with this year's output expected to fall below last year's.
summary.zh_hant: 印度政府已下令國有燃料零售商停止採購以食糖及主要甘蔗原料生產的乙醇，以抑制糖價上漲，措施將於11月1日開始的新供應年度生效。印度國有煉油企業聯合發布招標公告，計劃為新供應年度採購近110億升乙醇，明確不接受以甘蔗汁、食糖、糖漿及B級糖蜜生產的乙醇報價。印度是全球第二大食糖生產國，強烈厄爾尼諾導致當地遭遇十多年來最弱季風降雨，食糖供應趨緊，預計今年產量低於上年。
summary.zh_hans: 印度政府已下令国有燃料零售商停止采购以食糖及主要甘蔗原料生产的乙醇，以抑制糖价上涨，措施将于11月1日开始的新供应年度生效。印度国有炼油企业联合发布招标公告，计划为新供应年度采购近110亿升乙醇，明确不接受以甘蔗汁、食糖、糖浆及B级糖蜜生产的乙醇报价。印度是全球第二大食糖生产国，强烈厄尔尼诺导致当地遭遇十多年来最弱季风降雨，食糖供应趋紧，预计今年产量低于上年。

title.en: China unveils first homegrown 100,000-card AI supercluster in Shenzhen
title.zh_hant: 我國首個全國產十萬卡AI超集群亮相　超算智算原生融合
title.zh_hans: 我国首个全国产十万卡AI超集群亮相　超算智算原生融合

summary.en: At the 2026 National High-Performance Computing Conference in Shenzhen, China unveiled its first fully homegrown 100,000-card AI supercluster, the Sugon 8000, along with ten major application achievements. The system interconnects 100,000 AI accelerators at high speed; its core breakthrough is the native fusion of supercomputing and intelligent computing on a single infrastructure base, handling both high-precision scientific computation and large-model training and inference. Officials say its computing power could support creating a digital twin brain or simulating a universe spanning tens of billions of light-years.
summary.zh_hant: 正在深圳舉行的2026全國高性能計算學術大會上，今年剛建成的我國首個全國產十萬卡AI超集群「曙光8000」真機亮相，並發布十大重要應用成果。該系統把十萬張AI加速卡高速互聯，核心突破在於超算與智算在同一套算力底座上原生融合，既能跑高精度科學計算，也能做大模型訓練推理。官方形容，其算力足以支撐在計算機中創造數字孿生大腦，甚至模擬百億光年演化的宇宙。
summary.zh_hans: 正在深圳举行的2026全国高性能计算学术大会上，今年刚建成的我国首个全国产十万卡AI超集群「曙光8000」真机亮相，并发布十大重要应用成果。该系统把十万张AI加速卡高速互联，核心突破在于超算与智算在同一套算力底座上原生融合，既能跑高精度科学计算，也能做大模型训练推理。官方形容，其算力足以支撑在计算机中创造数字孪生大脑，甚至模拟百亿光年演化的宇宙。

title.en: Bai Lu cancels Bangkok fan meeting over safety concerns, offers travel compensation
title.zh_hant: 白鹿取消曼谷見面會　工作室主動承擔粉絲機酒退改損失
title.zh_hans: 白鹿取消曼谷见面会　工作室主动承担粉丝机酒退改损失

summary.en: Chinese actress Bai Lu's studio has cancelled her fan meeting in Bangkok originally set for October 25, citing a careful assessment of recent risk advisories and putting participant safety first. All ticket orders will be automatically refunded in full, and the studio will voluntarily cover fans' flight and hotel change or cancellation losses, with applications closing at 6pm on October 25. Organiser WeSpark confirmed the cancellation was a joint decision made after comprehensive evaluation by all parties.
summary.zh_hant: 內地藝人白鹿的工作室宣布，取消原定10月25日在曼谷舉行的見面會，原因是審慎評估近期相關風險提示後，決定以保障參與者安全為優先。工作室表示，所有購票訂單將由平台自動全額原路退回，粉絲因取消產生的機票及酒店退改費用損失亦由工作室主動承擔，申請截止日期為10月25日下午6時。主辦方WeSpark確認，取消是經多方綜合評估後的決定。
summary.zh_hans: 内地艺人白鹿的工作室宣布，取消原定10月25日在曼谷举行的见面会，原因是审慎评估近期相关风险提示后，决定以保障参与者安全为优先。工作室表示，所有购票订单将由平台自动全额原路退回，粉丝因取消产生的机票及酒店退改费用损失亦由工作室主动承担，申请截止日期为10月25日下午6时。主办方WeSpark确认，取消是经多方综合评估后的决定。

title.en: Chief Executive mourns passing of veteran educator Ng Hong-man
title.zh_hant: 行政長官哀悼吳康民逝世　讚揚其畢生致力愛國教育
title.zh_hans: 行政长官哀悼吴康民逝世　赞扬其毕生致力爱国教育

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee has expressed mourning over the passing of Ng Hong-man and extended deep condolences to his family. Lee praised Ng for a lifetime devoted to the nation: he served as a deputy to the National People's Congress for over 30 years from the 1970s, sat on the Preparatory Committee for the HKSAR and as a Hong Kong affairs adviser, contributing significantly to Hong Kong's smooth return to the motherland and lasting prosperity. Ng spent many years as principal and supervisor of Pui Kiu Middle School and chaired the Pui Kiu education body, dedicating his life to patriotic education and nurturing outstanding talent for the country and Hong Kong. He was awarded the Grand Bauhinia Medal in 1998.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超對吳康民逝世表示哀悼，並向其家人致以深切慰問。李家超讚揚吳康民一生心繫家國，自上世紀七十年代起擔任全國人大代表超過三十年，曾任香港特區籌備委員會委員和港事顧問，為香港順利回歸祖國和長期繁榮穩定作出重要貢獻。吳康民多年來出任培僑中學校長和校監，並擔任培僑教育機構董事會主席，畢生致力愛國教育事業，為國家和香港培育大量優秀人才，於1998年獲頒授大紫荊勳章。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超对吴康民逝世表示哀悼，并向其家人致以深切慰问。李家超赞扬吴康民一生心系家国，自上世纪七十年代起担任全国人大代表超过三十年，曾任香港特区筹备委员会委员和港事顾问，为香港顺利回归祖国和长期繁荣稳定作出重要贡献。吴康民多年来出任培侨中学校长和校监，并担任培侨教育机构董事会主席，毕生致力爱国教育事业，为国家和香港培育大量优秀人才，于1998年获颁授大紫荆勋章。

title.en: Transport chief Mable Chan to attend North Bund shipping forum in Shanghai
title.zh_hant: 運輸及物流局局長赴上海　出席北外灘國際航運論壇
title.zh_hans: 运输及物流局局长赴上海　出席北外滩国际航运论坛

summary.en: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan is travelling to Shanghai today to attend the 2026 North Bund International Shipping Forum. Themed 'Common Challenges, Common Mission: Jointly Promoting Resilient Global Shipping Development', the forum will see Chan attend the opening ceremony and the main international shipping forum to exchange views on global shipping development and cooperation. She will also visit a leading port enterprise to learn about its operations and the latest in port logistics, returning to Hong Kong tomorrow evening. Deputy Secretary Liu Chun-san will act as secretary in her absence.
summary.zh_hant: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶今日赴上海，出席2026北外灘國際航運論壇。論壇以「共同的挑戰，共同的使命—共促全球航運韌性發展」為主題，陳美寶將出席開幕式和國際海運主論壇，與與會者就國際航運發展和加強合作交流意見。她其後將到訪一家龍頭港口企業，了解其營運情況及港口物流產業最新發展，並於明日傍晚返港；離港期間由副局長廖振新署任局長。
summary.zh_hans: 运输及物流局局长陈美宝今日赴上海，出席2026北外滩国际航运论坛。论坛以「共同的挑战，共同的使命—共促全球航运韧性发展」为主题，陈美宝将出席开幕式和国际海运主论坛，与与会者就国际航运发展和加强合作交流意见。她其后将到访一家龙头港口企业，了解其营运情况及港口物流产业最新发展，并于明日傍晚返港；离港期间由副局长廖振新署任局长。

title.en: Red flags hoisted at three Hong Kong Island South beaches due to big waves
title.zh_hant: 大浪關係　赤柱正灘、石澳、大浪灣泳灘懸掛紅旗
title.zh_hans: 大浪关系　赤柱正滩、石澳、大浪湾泳滩悬挂红旗

summary.en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced today that red flags have been hoisted at Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in Southern District, Hong Kong Island, due to big waves. A red flag indicates it is dangerous to swim there, and the public are advised not to swim at these beaches.
summary.zh_hant: 康樂及文化事務署今日宣布，由於大浪關係，港島南區的赤柱正灘泳灘、石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘已懸掛紅旗，顯示在該處游泳會有危險，市民請勿在該處游泳。署方呼籲泳客注意安全，切勿冒險下水。
summary.zh_hans: 康乐及文化事务署今日宣布，由于大浪关系，港岛南区的赤柱正滩泳滩、石澳泳滩及大浪湾泳滩已悬挂红旗，显示在该处游泳会有危险，市民请勿在该处游泳。署方呼吁泳客注意安全，切勿冒险下水。

title.en: China's economy grows 4.6% in first three quarters; Q3 up 4.5%
title.zh_hant: 前三季度中國GDP達107.1萬億元　同比增長4.6%
title.zh_hans: 前三季度中国GDP达107.1万亿元　同比增长4.6%

summary.en: China's National Bureau of Statistics released economic data for the first three quarters this morning: GDP reached 10,710,710 million yuan, up 4.6% year on year at constant prices, with third-quarter growth of 4.5%. Key indicators stayed within the expected range. Huang Hanquan, president of the Academy of Macroeconomic Research at the NDRC, said the economy held steady under pressure, showing momentum shifting towards new drivers, improving structure and better quality. New productive forces represented by high-tech manufacturing, modern services and the intelligent economy are growing rapidly. Wei Chu, dean of Renmin University's School of Applied Economics, noted that AI adoption in above-scale manufacturers has passed 30%, while capital investment in AI and humanoid robotics rose 1.8 times year on year in Q3.
summary.zh_hant: 國家統計局今早公布今年前三季度國民經濟運行情況：初步核算，前三季度國內生產總值1071071億元，按不變價格計算同比增長4.6%，其中第三季度增長4.5%，主要指標保持在預期目標區間。國家發展改革委宏觀經濟研究院院長黃漢權表示，前三季度我國經濟頂壓前行、總體平穩，呈現動能向新、結構向優、質效向好的發展態勢；以高技術製造業、現代服務業、智能經濟為代表的新質生產力加快成長。中國人民大學應用經濟學院院長魏楚表示，規模以上製造業企業AI應用普及率超過三成，第三季人工智能、人形機器人等領域資本投資同比擴大1.8倍。
summary.zh_hans: 国家统计局今早公布今年前三季度国民经济运行情况：初步核算，前三季度国内生产总值1071071亿元，按不变价格计算同比增长4.6%，其中第三季度增长4.5%，主要指标保持在预期目标区间。国家发展改革委宏观经济研究院院长黄汉权表示，前三季度我国经济顶压前行、总体平稳，呈现动能向新、结构向优、质效向好的发展态势；以高技术制造业、现代服务业、智能经济为代表的新质生产力加快成长。中国人民大学应用经济学院院长魏楚表示，规模以上制造业企业AI应用普及率超过三成，第三季人工智能、人形机器人等领域资本投资同比扩大1.8倍。

title.en: Huiyuan Group stops producing 'Huiyuan' juice, launches new 'Zanjia Guoyuan' brand after investor dispute
title.zh_hant: 匯源集團宣布停產「匯源」果汁　啟用新品牌「咱家果源」
title.zh_hans: 汇源集团宣布停产「汇源」果汁　启用新品牌「咱家果源」

summary.en: Huiyuan Group said this morning it will no longer produce juice under the 'Huiyuan' trademark and will end all cooperation involving the brand, launching 'Zanjia Guoyuan' (咱家果源) as its replacement while continuing to pursue legal action against restructuring investor Shanghai Wensheng Asset Management. Huiyuan said Wensheng failed to pay 850 million yuan of promised investment and did not use the 750 million yuan already paid for business operations as agreed, constituting a fundamental breach of the restructuring deal. The dispute went public in August 2025; a Fuzhou court has since ordered a Huiyuan-affiliated company to pay over 97 million yuan in compensation and stop using the 'Huiyuan' name. Founded in 1992, Huiyuan became the national juice brand for generations and listed in Hong Kong in 2007.
summary.zh_hant: 匯源集團今日上午發表聲明，宣布集團及下屬企業將不再生產帶有「匯源」商標的果汁產品，終止與該商標相關的一切合作，全面啟用新品牌「咱家果源」，同時繼續就重整投資人上海文盛資產管理股份有限公司的違約行為維權。聲明指，文盛資產承諾的投資款中有8.5億元尚未支付，已到賬的7.5億元亦未按協議投入企業經營，構成根本違約。雙方矛盾自2025年8月公開化，近日福州市中級人民法院一審判決匯源關聯企業賠償9700餘萬元，並停止使用「匯源」字號。匯源品牌始創於1992年，曾是幾代人記憶中的「國民果汁」，2007年在港交所上市。
summary.zh_hans: 汇源集团今日上午发表声明，宣布集团及下属企业将不再生产带有「汇源」商标的果汁产品，终止与该商标相关的一切合作，全面启用新品牌「咱家果源」，同时继续就重整投资人上海文盛资产管理股份有限公司的违约行为维权。声明指，文盛资产承诺的投资款中有8.5亿元尚未支付，已到账的7.5亿元亦未按协议投入企业经营，构成根本违约。双方矛盾自2025年8月公开化，近日福州市中级人民法院一审判决汇源关联企业赔偿9700余万元，并停止使用「汇源」字号。汇源品牌始创于1992年，曾是几代人记忆中的「国民果汁」，2007年在港交所上市。

title.en: John Lee meets AIIB president Zou Jiayi ahead of APEC finance ministers' meeting
title.zh_hant: 行政長官與亞洲基礎設施投資銀行行長鄒加怡會面
title.zh_hans: 行政长官与亚洲基础设施投资银行行长邹加怡会面

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee met AIIB president Zou Jiayi today. Zou is leading a delegation to Hong Kong for the APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting, hosted here on October 20-21. Lee said Hong Kong has topped the world's freest economy ranking and ranks third globally and first in Asia in the Global Financial Centres Index, and can flexibly channel funding for the AIIB's carbon-neutral and green economy transition projects. He welcomed the AIIB's upcoming Hong Kong office, which will combine financing and operations functions, as a vote of confidence in Hong Kong as the gateway connecting the nation with the world; the government will fully assist its establishment and operation.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日與亞洲基礎設施投資銀行行長鄒加怡會面。鄒加怡率團訪港，出席明日（20日）起一連兩日在香港舉行的二○二六年亞太區經濟合作組織財政部長會。李家超表示，香港蟬聯全球最自由經濟體榜首，在《全球金融中心指數》位列全球第三、亞洲第一，能為亞投行的碳中和與綠色經濟轉型等項目提供靈活的資金配置支援。他很高興亞投行即將在香港設立兼具融資和營運雙重功能的辦事處，體現香港作為連接國家與世界的門戶，特區政府會全力協助辦事處的設立和運作。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日与亚洲基础设施投资银行行长邹加怡会面。邹加怡率团访港，出席明日（20日）起一连两日在香港举行的二○二六年亚太区经济合作组织财政部长会。李家超表示，香港蝉联全球最自由经济体榜首，在《全球金融中心指数》位列全球第三、亚洲第一，能为亚投行的碳中和与绿色经济转型等项目提供灵活的资金配置支援。他很高兴亚投行即将在香港设立兼具融资和营运双重功能的办事处，体现香港作为连接国家与世界的门户，特区政府会全力协助办事处的设立和运作。

title.en: Hong Kong talent office hosts careers expo in London with over 200 jobs on offer
title.zh_hant: 人才辦聯同港企內地企業倫敦辦人才機遇展　逾50機構提供逾200職位
title.zh_hans: 人才办联同港企内地企业伦敦办人才机遇展　逾50机构提供逾200职位

summary.en: The Hong Kong Talent Engage office, together with Hong Kong and mainland enterprises, hosted a talent opportunities expo in London. More than 50 companies and organisations offered over 200 vacancies spanning banking and finance, innovation and technology, engineering and construction, and professional services, drawing over 4,500 visits. Talent Engage director Chen Haijin said the expo lets global talent learn about career prospects in Hong Kong and the mainland and meet employers face to face. Greater Bay Area development commissioner Lin Yawen said in a keynote that the Northern Metropolis will be Hong Kong's main platform for participating in Greater Bay Area development, bringing vast opportunities.
summary.zh_hant: 香港人才服務辦公室聯同香港和內地企業，於英國倫敦舉辦人才機遇展。逾50家香港和內地企業及機構共提供逾200個職位空缺，涵蓋銀行與金融、創新科技、工程與建築、專業服務等領域，吸引逾4500人次參與。人才辦總監陳海勁致辭表示，機遇展讓全球人才了解香港和內地的事業發展，並與企業直接交流和進行職業配對。粵港澳大灣區發展專員林雅雯在專題演講中表示，北部都會區是香港深度參與大灣區建設、主動融入和服務國家發展大局的主平台，勢將帶來龐大機遇。
summary.zh_hans: 香港人才服务办公室联同香港和内地企业，于英国伦敦举办人才机遇展。逾50家香港和内地企业及机构共提供逾200个职位空缺，涵盖银行与金融、创新科技、工程与建筑、专业服务等领域，吸引逾4500人次参与。人才办总监陈海劲致辞表示，机遇展让全球人才了解香港和内地的事业发展，并与企业直接交流和进行职业配对。粤港澳大湾区发展专员林雅雯在专题演讲中表示，北部都会区是香港深度参与大湾区建设、主动融入和服务国家发展大局的主平台，势将带来庞大机遇。

title.en: Red flag hoisted at Clear Water Bay Second Beach as big waves continue
title.zh_hant: 大浪持續　清水灣第二灣泳灘懸掛紅旗
title.zh_hans: 大浪持续　清水湾第二湾泳滩悬挂红旗

summary.en: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced today that a red flag has been hoisted at Clear Water Bay Second Beach in Sai Kung because of big waves, signalling dangerous swimming conditions; swimmers are advised to stay out of the water. Earlier today the department hoisted red flags at Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach on Hong Kong Island South for the same reason.
summary.zh_hant: 康樂及文化事務署今日宣布，由於大浪關係，西貢區的清水灣第二灣泳灘已懸掛紅旗，顯示在該處游泳會有危險，市民請勿在該處游泳。今早較早時候，署方亦宣布因大浪在港島南區的赤柱正灘泳灘、石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘懸掛紅旗。
summary.zh_hans: 康乐及文化事务署今日宣布，由于大浪关系，西贡区的清水湾第二湾泳滩已悬挂红旗，显示在该处游泳会有危险，市民请勿在该处游泳。今早较早时候，署方亦宣布因大浪在港岛南区的赤柱正滩泳滩、石澳泳滩及大浪湾泳滩悬挂红旗。

title.en: CHP logs serious child flu case: 6-year-old girl in critical condition with influenza A (H1) and shock
title.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心錄得一宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案　六歲女童情況危殆
title.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心录得一宗儿童感染流感的严重个案　六岁女童情况危殆

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection today recorded a serious child influenza case: a previously healthy 6-year-old girl who developed fever on October 15, was admitted to Tuen Mun Hospital, and transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit on October 17 as her condition deteriorated. Her respiratory sample tested positive for influenza A (H1) and she was clinically diagnosed with influenza A complicated by shock; she remains in critical condition. She had no travel history during the incubation period and had not received this season's flu vaccine. CHP controller Dr Tsui Lok-kin said Hong Kong has been in flu season for over three months with activity remaining high; 24 serious child cases have been logged this season, with 20 discharged, three critical and one death. He urged the public to get vaccinated as soon as possible.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心今日錄得一宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案：一名健康良好的六歲女童於十月十五日因發燒、流鼻水、嘔吐及食慾不振到屯門醫院急症室求診，需留院治理，十月十七日因情況轉壞轉送兒童深切治療部。她的呼吸道樣本證實對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性反應，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發休克，目前情況危殆。女童潛伏期內沒有外遊，尚未接種二○二六／二七年度季節性流感疫苗。中心總監徐樂堅醫生表示，香港自六月下旬進入流感季節已逾三個月，本地流感活躍程度仍維持高水平，本季節累計錄得24宗兒童嚴重個案，當中20宗已康復出院、三宗危殆及一宗死亡，呼籲市民盡快接種季節性流感疫苗。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心今日录得一宗儿童感染流感的严重个案：一名健康良好的六岁女童于十月十五日因发烧、流鼻水、呕吐及食欲不振到屯门医院急症室求诊，需留院治理，十月十七日因情况转坏转送儿童深切治疗部。她的呼吸道样本证实对甲型（H1）流感病毒呈阳性反应，临床诊断为甲型流感并发休克，目前情况危殆。女童潜伏期内没有外游，尚未接种二○二六／二七年度季节性流感疫苗。中心总监徐乐坚医生表示，香港自六月下旬进入流感季节已逾三个月，本地流感活跃程度仍维持高水平，本季节累计录得24宗儿童严重个案，当中20宗已康复出院、三宗危殆及一宗死亡，呼吁市民尽快接种季节性流感疫苗。

title.en: Departments step up measures as inbound passenger flow surges at Huanggang Port
title.zh_hant: 各部門加強措施應對皇崗口岸入境人流高峰
title.zh_hans: 各部门加强措施应对皇岗口岸入境人流高峰

summary.en: The Security Bureau said inbound passenger flow at Huanggang Port began building from 2pm today: about 9,401 travellers entered Hong Kong between 2pm and 4pm, up 366% from the same period in previous years, with the southbound flow expected to grow further tonight. All immigration lanes at the L4 arrival hall are open, and Immigration will work with police on crowd diversion and control at L4 and L2 as needed. The Transport Department has deployed around 120 franchised buses, 40 green minibuses and 130 cross-boundary coaches, with peak frequencies up to every two to three minutes, to speed up dispersal. The bureau urged travellers to plan ahead, use the 'Hok Yuen Tung' platform to check queue times, and travel off-peak.
summary.zh_hant: 保安局表示，皇崗口岸今日下午二時起南下入境人流開始增多，下午二時至四時期間約有9,401名旅客經皇崗口岸入境回港，較過往同期上升366%，預計南下人流今晚會進一步增多。入境處已開放L4層入境大堂所有過關通道，並會視乎實際情況聯同警務處於L4及L2層實施人流分流及管制。運輸署已安排約120架專營巴士、40架專線小巴和130架跨境巴士投入服務及作後備支援，繁忙時段班次最高可加密至每兩至三分鐘一班，加快疏導入境人士。保安局呼籲市民及早規劃行程，透過「口岸通」平台查看輪候時間，並盡量錯峰出行。
summary.zh_hans: 保安局表示，皇岗口岸今日下午二时起南下入境人流开始增多，下午二时至四时期间约有9,401名旅客经皇岗口岸入境回港，较过往同期上升366%，预计南下人流今晚会进一步增多。入境处已开放L4层入境大堂所有过关通道，并会视乎实际情况联同警务处于L4及L2层实施人流分流及管制。运输署已安排约120架专营巴士、40架专线小巴和130架跨境巴士投入服务及作后备支援，繁忙时段班次最高可加密至每两至三分钟一班，加快疏导入境人士。保安局呼吁市民及早规划行程，透过「口岸通」平台查看轮候时间，并尽量错峰出行。

title.en: Department of Health reports latest Legionnaires' disease figures: 3 community cases in past week
title.zh_hant: 衞生署公布退伍軍人病個案最新情況　一周錄得三宗社區感染個案
title.zh_hans: 卫生署公布退伍军人病个案最新情况　一周录得三宗社区感染个案

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection today released the latest Legionnaires' disease figures: three community-acquired cases were recorded between October 11 and 17, involving men aged 44 to 67 living in Tai Po and Kwai Tsing districts. The cases appear sporadic with no epidemiological links to earlier cases, and investigations into possible sources are under way. As of October 17, 160 cases have been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. The department reminded the public to use and maintain properly designed artificial water systems, and advised susceptible people to avoid humidifiers and other mist-generating devices.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生防護中心今日公布退伍軍人病個案最新數字：在十月十一日至十七日期間錄得三宗社區感染個案，涉及三名年齡介乎44至67歲的男子，分別居於大埔區及葵青區。初步調查顯示上述個案屬散發個案，沒有資料顯示與早前其他確診個案有流行病學關連，中心正展開調查以找出可能的感染源頭。截至十月十七日，今年累計錄得160宗退伍軍人病個案；本港於二○二五年及二○二四年分別錄得167及135宗。中心提醒市民應使用和保養妥善設計的人造供水系統，易受感染人士則需避免使用加濕器或其他可產生霧氣的設備。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生防护中心今日公布退伍军人病个案最新数字：在十月十一日至十七日期间录得三宗社区感染个案，涉及三名年龄介乎44至67岁的男子，分别居于大埔区及葵青区。初步调查显示上述个案属散发个案，没有资料显示与早前其他确诊个案有流行病学关连，中心正展开调查以找出可能的感染源头。截至十月十七日，今年累计录得160宗退伍军人病个案；本港于二○二五年及二○二四年分别录得167及135宗。中心提醒市民应使用和保养妥善设计的人造供水系统，易受感染人士则需避免使用加湿器或其他可产生雾气的设备。

title.en: Director of Health leads delegation to WHO Western Pacific Regional Committee meeting in Manila
title.zh_hant: 衞生署署長出席世衞西太平洋區域委員會會議
title.zh_hans: 卫生署署长出席世卫西太平洋区域委员会会议

summary.en: Director of Health Dr Lam Man-kin today led a department delegation to Manila for the 77th session of the WHO Regional Committee for the Western Pacific, exchanging views with counterparts on major global health issues. Dr Lam briefed the meeting on Hong Kong's latest public health developments, saying the city is committed to a resilient public health system and that key health indicators such as life expectancy and maternal and infant mortality remain among the world's best. He said Hong Kong is using digital health tools and AI to optimise resource allocation and primary healthcare, and that the WHO Western Pacific vision of 'health for all' aligns closely with the healthcare directions in Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the Policy Address. The department has been designated a WHO collaborating centre for tobacco control and traditional medicine for over a decade.
summary.zh_hant: 衞生署署長林文健醫生今日率領衞生署代表團到菲律賓馬尼拉，出席世界衞生組織西太平洋區域委員會第七十七屆會議，與各地代表就多個全球共同關心的重大健康議題深入交流。林文健醫生在會上匯報香港公共衞生的最新情況和挑戰，指香港致力維持堅韌的公共衞生體系，多項核心健康指標如人口預期壽命、孕婦及嬰兒死亡率等一直居於全球前列。香港正積極善用數碼健康工具及人工智能，優化資源配置和提升基層醫療效率；世衞西太平洋地區「共建全民健康」願景，與《香港第一個五年規劃》及《施政報告》有關醫療衞生的策略方向高度契合。衞生署已連續逾十載獲指定為世衞控煙及煙癮治療合作中心和世衞傳統醫藥合作中心。
summary.zh_hans: 卫生署署长林文健医生今日率领卫生署代表团到菲律宾马尼拉，出席世界卫生组织西太平洋区域委员会第七十七届会议，与各地代表就多个全球共同关心的重大健康议题深入交流。林文健医生在会上汇报香港公共卫生的最新情况和挑战，指香港致力维持坚韧的公共卫生体系，多项核心健康指标如人口预期寿命、孕妇及婴儿死亡率等一直居于全球前列。香港正积极善用数码健康工具及人工智能，优化资源配置和提升基层医疗效率；世卫西太平洋地区「共建全民健康」愿景，与《香港第一个五年规划》及《施政报告》有关医疗卫生的策略方向高度契合。卫生署已连续逾十载获指定为世卫控烟及烟瘾治疗合作中心和世卫传统医药合作中心。

title.en: Asia markets close mixed: KOSPI up 1.76%, Nikkei down 0.62%; Hong Kong closed for holiday
title.zh_hant: 亞洲股市收市個別發展　韓股升1.76%日經跌0.62%　港股休市
title.zh_hans: 亚洲股市收市个别发展　韩股升1.76%日经跌0.62%　港股休市

summary.en: Asian markets closed mixed on Monday: South Korea's KOSPI rose 1.76% to 5,768.01 and the KOSDAQ gained 1.78%, while Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 0.62% to 64,916.70 and the TOPIX edged up 0.04%. Mainland China's Shanghai Composite rose 0.39% to 3,730.92, but the ChiNext dropped 0.94%. Hong Kong's securities market was closed for the Chung Yeung Festival holiday, with trading set to resume on Tuesday. The session followed renewed investor concern over the financing demands of AI infrastructure, which pressured chip stocks; China's better-than-expected third-quarter GDP growth of 4.5% provided support to regional sentiment.
summary.zh_hant: 亞洲股市今日收市個別發展：韓國KOSPI升1.76%收報5,768.01點，KOSDAQ升1.78%；日本日經225指數跌0.62%收報64,916.70點，TOPIX微升0.04%。內地A股上證指數升0.39%收報3,730.92點，創業板指則跌0.94%。香港證券市場因重陽節翌日假期休市，明日恢復交易。市場繼續關注人工智能基建龐大融資需求引發的疑慮，晶片股受壓；中國今早公布第三季GDP增長4.5%勝預期，為區內氣氛帶來支持。
summary.zh_hans: 亚洲股市今日收市个别发展：韩国KOSPI升1.76%收报5,768.01点，KOSDAQ升1.78%；日本日经225指数跌0.62%收报64,916.70点，TOPIX微升0.04%。内地A股上证指数升0.39%收报3,730.92点，创业板指则跌0.94%。香港证券市场因重阳节翌日假期休市，明日恢复交易。市场继续关注人工智能基建庞大融资需求引发的疑虑，芯片股受压；中国今早公布第三季GDP增长4.5%胜预期，为区内气氛带来支持。

title.en: French PM orders 'very limited, localized' curfews to curb rioting and looting
title.zh_hant: 法國總理下令實施「非常有限、局部」宵禁　遏止暴亂搶劫
title.zh_hans: 法国总理下令实施「非常有限、局部」宵禁　遏止暴乱抢劫

summary.en: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has instructed prefects to impose 'very limited' and 'localized' curfews in cities to prevent further rioting and looting, after weekend violence that targeted city halls, public buildings and thousands of businesses across France. The violence began during nationwide protests against rising living costs and poor school conditions; at least 2,400 people were arrested and authorities estimate at least 3,000 businesses were damaged or looted. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez offered his resignation on Sunday, but President Emmanuel Macron refused it while demanding full transparency over intelligence and planning failures. Lecornu said curfew details would be announced later Monday; Paris will not face a city-wide curfew.
summary.zh_hant: 法國總理勒科爾尼指示各省省長在多個城市實施「非常有限」且「局部」嘅宵禁，以遏止周末蔓延全國嘅暴亂同搶劫。今次騷亂源於抗議生活成本上漲同校園條件惡劣嘅全國示威，暴力分子衝擊市政廳、公共建築同數以千計嘅商店；全國至少2,400人被捕，當局估計至少3,000間商店被破壞或搶劫。內政部長努涅斯周日請辭，但總統馬克龍拒絕接受，同時要求佢全面交代情報同部署失誤。總理稱宵禁具體範圍將於周一稍後公布，巴黎唔會實施全市宵禁。
summary.zh_hans: 法国总理勒科尔尼指示各省省长在多个城市实施「非常有限」且「局部」的宵禁，以遏止周末蔓延全国的暴乱和抢劫。这次骚乱源于抗议生活成本上涨和校园条件恶劣的全国示威，暴力分子冲击市政厅、公共建筑和数以千计的商店；全国至少2,400人被捕，当局估计至少3,000间商店被破坏或抢劫。内政部长努涅斯周日请辞，但总统马克龙拒绝接受，同时要求他全面交代情报和部署失误。总理称宵禁具体范围将于周一稍后公布，巴黎不会实施全市宵禁。

title.en: Hong Kong wins one silver and two bronzes on first competition day of Asian Para Games
title.zh_hant: 亞殘運首個比賽日港隊奪1銀2銅　羅淑佩致賀
title.zh_hans: 亚残运首个比赛日港队夺1银2铜　罗淑佩致贺

summary.en: Hong Kong athletes won one silver and two bronze medals on the first competition day of the 5th Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Swimmer Lau Chiu-yee took silver in the women's 200m freestyle S14, while Wong Hon-yin claimed bronze in the men's 200m freestyle S14; wheelchair fencer Yu Chui-yee took bronze in the women's foil individual Category A. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law congratulated the medalists and praised their determination.
summary.zh_hant: 在日本愛知・名古屋舉行嘅第五屆亞洲殘疾人運動會首個比賽日，香港代表團奪得1銀2銅。游泳代表劉肖儀在女子200米自由泳S14級奪得銀牌；黃漢彥在男子200米自由泳S14級奪得銅牌；輪椅劍擊代表余翠怡在女子花劍個人A級奪得銅牌。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩向三位得獎運動員致賀，讚揚佢哋展現堅毅精神。
summary.zh_hans: 在日本爱知・名古屋举行的第五届亚洲残疾人运动会首个比赛日，香港代表团夺得1银2铜。游泳代表刘肖仪在女子200米自由泳S14级夺得银牌；黄汉彦在男子200米自由泳S14级夺得铜牌；轮椅剑击代表余翠怡在女子花剑个人A级夺得铜牌。文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩向三位得奖运动员致贺，赞扬他们展现坚毅精神。

title.en: HK hosts APEC finance ministers' meeting for first time; Paul Chan vows good impression
title.zh_hant: 香港首辦APEC財政部長會議　陳茂波：要畀官員留好印象
title.zh_hans: 香港首办APEC财政部长会议　陈茂波：要让官员留好印象

summary.en: The 33rd APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting opens in Wan Chai on Tuesday for a two-day session, the first time Hong Kong is hosting the ministerial meeting. Finance Minister Lan Fo'an will chair the sessions. Financial Secretary Paul Chan told an RTHK programme that the government aims to leave APEC officials with a good impression and showcase Hong Kong's strengths. The agenda covers livelihood financial policies, financing for digital infrastructure, inclusive finance, and youth financial talent exchanges. An APEC leaders' meeting follows in Shenzhen in November.
summary.zh_hant: 第33屆亞太經合組織財政部長會議周二（10月20日）起一連兩日在灣仔舉行，係香港首次主辦部長級會議，由財政部部長藍佛安主持。財政司司長陳茂波接受港台訪問時表示，政府要畀APEC官員留下好印象、展示香港優勢。會議四大議題包括民生金融政策、數字基建融資、普惠金融，以及青年金融人才交流合作；之後11月再喺深圳舉行APEC領袖會議。
summary.zh_hans: 第33届亚太经合组织财政部长会议周二（10月20日）起一连两日在湾仔举行，是香港首次主办部长级会议，由财政部部长蓝佛安主持。财政司司长陈茂波接受港台访问时表示，政府要让APEC官员留下好印象、展示香港优势。会议四大议题包括民生金融政策、数字基建融资、普惠金融，以及青年金融人才交流合作；之后11月再在深圳举行APEC领袖会议。

title.en: SFC's Julia Leung: young growth firms now 30% of HK listings, up from 10%
title.zh_hant: 證監會梁鳳儀：成長型公司佔港股上市數目升至30%
title.zh_hans: 证监会梁凤仪：成长型公司占港股上市数目升至30%

summary.en: Hong Kong's markets are seeing a rising share of listings by young, high-growth companies, Securities and Futures Commission CEO Julia Leung said Monday at a seminar in Tokyo. Such firms — typically three to five years old and not yet consistently profitable, many in biotech and AI — now account for 30% of listings, up from 10% in 2023. Leung described the market as 'very vibrant' but cautioned that issuers must prioritise quality over quantity if conditions weaken. She noted Hong Kong benefits from China's complete AI industry chain.
summary.zh_hant: 證監會行政總裁梁鳳儀周一喺東京出席研討會時表示，港股市場愈嚟愈多成長型公司上市——呢類公司多數成立三至五年、未持續盈利但增長潛力強，集中生物科技同人工智能領域，佔上市數目比例由2023年嘅10%升至現時30%。佢形容市場「非常暢旺」，但提醒市況轉弱時要「重質不重量」。梁鳳儀又指，香港受惠於中國完整嘅人工智能產業鏈。
summary.zh_hans: 证监会行政总裁梁凤仪周一在东京出席研讨会时表示，港股市场越来越多成长型公司上市——这类公司多数成立三至五年、未持续盈利但增长潜力强，集中生物科技和人工智能领域，占上市数目比例由2023年的10%升至现时30%。她形容市场「非常畅旺」，但提醒市况转弱时要「重质不重量」。梁凤仪又指，香港受惠于中国完整的人工智能产业链。
